title: Matam Husain ka
body:
Matam Husain ka (4)
(1) Hazar bar jiye hazar bar mare
Harek aan kare kabhi kahi na ruke
Sadahi hota rahega......Husain ...
Matam Husain ka (2).
(2) Qalandaro ne kiya Sikandaro ne kiya
Malaeqa ne kiya payambaro ne kiya
Jahan karta he Sara .....Husain....
Matam Husain ka (2).
(3) Ye waqiya bhi hua ke ghar me kuch na bacha
To mane bachoo ko khud apne bech diya
Magar na ghar me ruka tha..... Husain..
Matam Husain ka (2).
(4) Kiye the usne sitam diye the dard o alam
Usi ke ghar me kiya bahan ne Bhai ka gham
Yazid rok na paya ....Husain....
Matam Husain ka (2)
(5) Me jab jahan se chala kafan bhi mujko diya
Jo pahele bandha that vo bandh khol diya
Me qabr me bhi karunga.....Husain...
Matam Husain ka (2)
(6) Suno bayan Jara mile aman jara
Faristo dekh to lo mere nishan jara
Dikha raha he ye sina ....Husain....
Matam Husain ka (2)
(7) Kahi karaya nahi kabhi bataya nahi
Kisine bachpan me mujhe sikhaya nahi
Ye hath khud hi tha karta...Husain...
Matam Husain ka (2)
(8) Hai dil me shah ka gham he meri aankh bhi num
Hai sar pe saya figan Jo bawafa ka alam
To umr bhar me karunga.....Husain...
Matam Husain ka (2)
(9) Utha ke parda jab imam aayenge
To sehne kaba me alam sajayenge
Vahan pe shan se hoga....Husain...
Matam Husain ka (2)
(10) Jo mushkilo me ghire ilaj yaad rakhe
Bicha ke farshe aza vo apne ghar me kare
Hai mushkilo me sahara.....Husain...
Matam Husain ka (2)
(11) Pade ''Rehan'' agar pade "suhail" agar
To noha kyu na likhe bataiye "Haider"
Inhone virse me paya... Husain...
Matam Husain ka (2).
Matam Husain ka (4)...
